description.p: A small native GNOME player for FRISKY Radio's four channels: Frisky, Deep, Chill and Classics.

It shows the cover art and tracklist of the DJ mix currently on air, draws a live visualiser over the artwork, and integrates with the system media controls so you can play, stop and switch channels without opening the window.

This is an unofficial client. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by FRISKY. Channel names, artwork and audio belong to FRISKY and its artists. Streaming at 96 kbps is free; higher bitrates require a FRISKY subscription.

ul.li: The Compact Player command now reliably restores the compact window after any manual resize
The buffering animation now stops when playback connects or is stopped, avoiding needless background redraws
A delayed retry from an old stream can no longer restart a newer playback request
Artwork downloads are bounded in memory even when the server uses a chunked response
Switching mixes no longer leaves the previous mix's cover art on screen
Clicking a mix notification now opens the player instead of doing nothing
The Keyboard Shortcuts window works, and Ctrl+N skips to the next channel
Stopping or switching channel during a premium quality check is no longer overridden a moment later
A change on FRISKY's side can no longer leave every channel blank at once
Now playing keeps updating after the machine wakes from suspend
Cover art no longer accumulates on disk without limit
The audio device is released properly when the app quits
Pick which audio output to play to, for when the system default is not where the speakers are
An Arch Linux package, built against the system GTK and GStreamer
A travelling wave replaces the spinner while buffering
The Classics play button reads as a button rather than as disabled
The AppImage is now self-contained: GTK, libadwaita and GStreamer are bundled, so nothing needs installing
The mini player is layered over the cover art, blurred, beneath the channel gradient and the visualiser
A next-channel button, with the transport row balanced around play
The mini player is now a single row: the title bar folds into it and the window becomes the channel gradient
Mix progress, from the broadcast schedule
Channel chips inline in the mini player
A close button in the mini player, which had none
Mix-change notifications can be switched off in Preferences
All four FRISKY channels with brand-accurate styling
Cover art and tracklist for the mix currently on air
Live audio visualiser that fades away on hover
MPRIS media controls and mix-change notifications
Optional login for subscriber audio quality
